statement.name: GetGlossaryTermDescription
statement.sql: SELECT UPPER(GlossaryTerm) AS GlossaryTerm, Description, Abbreviation, IndexCharacter, HTMLAnchor, IsDescriptionHTML FROM GlossaryTerm

statement.name: GetExternalSystemUrl
statement.sql: SELECT DimensionValue as ExternalSystemUrl, ExternalSystemCode, ExternalSystemDimensionCode FROM ExternalSystemDimensionValue
